F1: The Error-level logs at xorm_store.go:534-537, 554-557 and 576-579 are leftover debug output: they record normal progress and full ID lists on every batch, even when nothing is deleted, which floods ERROR logs and will set off false alerts.
F2: The quadratic string building is real, but it only runs on SQLite when the batch size is set above 999, which is not the default; it costs CPU time and memory churn but does not cause wrong behavior.
F3: This only fails if an operator sets the batch size above the driver's bind-parameter limit (about 65k for MySQL and Postgres), which is a misconfiguration; guarding against it is hardening, not a defect in the change.
